# Concrete callback packets and common restart fuel

Recursive packet and uniform receipt callback: `b19f57ac0`.
Selected-prefix packet transport: `4d352a3e2`.
Common callback and restart work fuel: `765a826ae`.
The goal stays ACTIVE. This checkpoint does not complete the formalization.
The initial pull was already up to date. A fresh main fetch retains imported
main `153e1a211b56dd78bd22f6b427fb78e673041d55`.

## Recursive invariant packet

SourcePruningEnumerationRecursive.Packet contains the current native Context,
enumeration Safe, PendingReferences, CacheValid, existential dependency levels
and frontier, and allocated raw IDs for every pending metadata entry.
The full endpoint memos are explicit. Queries use that endpoint's memos.query.
Existential order supports rendering. It is not a scheduler termination measure.

captured_post transports the literal SAME captured cache and metadata through
an actual native Post. Only the Caller, inventory and full memos change.
Existing native Keeps transport preserves realized handles and candidate flags.
It does not move a branch output's cache to the final aggregate endpoint.

callback_frame transports the packet to the returned core and metadata.
It requires returned Safe explicitly. Concrete callback completion supplies
that fact through RenderStable.safe. A compression Frame alone does not imply
Safe. Frame preserves pending references and the indexed-cache components.
The actual callback output supplies returned dependency order and pending IDs.

receipt_packet derives this packet BEFORE callback execution from the current
native Context, completed Admitted receipt, actual FragmentHistory, returned
PendingReferences, original dependency order and original pending-ID bounds.
FragmentHistory advances the frontier and lifts the old ID bounds through
counter growth. No future callback success or returned cache is an input.

## Stable concrete callback receipts

ReceiptCallbackFuel.completes uses the SAME inputs as ReceiptCallback.completes.
It calls recordTypes_inl_complete_bounded once. One fixed result, returned
core and finite callback fuel then work at EVERY larger fuel. recordTypes_moreFuel
retains that exact successful core. CallbackExact gives the exact singleton
raw observation. No error rows are erased from an insufficient bounded call.

Every older capability remains present: RenderStable, Frame, dependency order,
types/openHoles/typing equations, Admitted, FragmentHistory, conditional Pending,
selection equality and returned pending-ID bounds. Follows now holds for every
increased callback fuel. Non-complete receipts keep the original True case.
Earlier receipt definitions and completion interfaces remain unchanged.

## Prefix packet transport

Recursive.prefix_packet consumes the complete existing PrefixValid and the
initial Packet. A parked cache retains the original Caller and full memos.
A narrowed cache retains its actual returned Caller, saved query equality
and native Post. Both caches retain the recursive packet, original counter,
pending metadata IDs and dependency order. Missing cache cases make no new
safety assertion. PrefixValid remains intact, including its full conditional
ordinary capability and its reached numeric Ranges requirement.

packet_prefix_complete inspects the ACTUAL restart decision. A selected
expansion derives common sufficient prefix fuel from the current packet.
None, done and stuck need no expansion capability. Every larger fuel retains
PrefixValid for the same actual selected target. The proof does not assume a
future selected result or identify function-valued results across all fuels.

## Concrete callback and next prefix use one work fuel

Recursive.callback_complete takes only the current Packet and the allocated
fragment bound. One concrete recordTypes completion derives the returned
packet, RenderStable, Frame and metadata equations. Every larger callback
fuel retains the SAME result/core and exact raw singleton. For every supplied
recursive continuation, continueWith has the actual source equation: true
prunes the branch; false invokes that continuation at the returned metadata,
framed cache and actual restart decision. No completion of that continuation
is asserted or required.

callback_prefix_complete derives both callback and next-prefix witnesses.
It chooses callbackFuel + prefixFuel. At every larger work bound, the callback
has its exact original result/core. Its false branch and actual expand decision
derive PrefixValid for the next runPrefix at that SAME combined work bound.
The next call uses the returned metadata/cache, unchanged current Caller
and its full memos. The original prefix capability is not weakened.

The producer has no future callback, cache, native Post, numeric range or
recursive-success premise. Native Post and observation premises occur only
in the separate transport lemmas that analyse those actual observations.
Independent review confirmed this distinction and the common-fuel arithmetic.

linter.all. Ten strict attempts have eight passes and two failures. One
failure reports six missing public Packet field docstrings. The other
reports redundant rewrites after case analysis had already reduced the
actual decision. The final sources fix both issues. Every failed source
and raw log is retained. No placeholder, new axiom or linter suppression is added.

Three serial helper builds and installed Audit pass. Audit checks 77088
theorem dependencies in 3789 jobs. Lake replays the existing unused inputs
warning in InternedFreshOrdinaryClosedCompletion. Its source stays unchanged.
Every new strict module has no warning.

Installed public readback covers 22 declarations and full Packet, PrefixValid

No ellipsis is present. Reported axioms are limited to propext, Classical.choice
and Quot.sound. Heavy jobs run serially under a 4G cap and five-minute limit.
Evidence is in `lean/restart-evidence/20261026-native-recursive-packet`.

## Strongest end-to-end theorem and next work

H6 remains SourceCurrentColdFiniteWarmCalls.constructed_node_calls. Covered
closed construction and valid initial constraint allocation history derive
a complete prescribed finite number of modeled node-processing rounds,
sufficient finite fuel and one mathematical word width chosen after
construction. With empty inherited payload, the final available value has
exactly the initial finite-tree language under the modeled guard/solver
interfaces. The full recursive typing/pruning driver is not proved.

This checkpoint covers a concrete callback and its NEXT selected prefix.
It does not prove a whole recursive subtree, the subsequent sibling or a
finite completion forecast. The next preservation theorem should analyse
ACTUAL continuable native observations. It must not use a future success,
valid cache or Ranges receipt as an initial completion admission.

The first prerequisite is an actual-native-done Post/receipt export.
SourceCurrentAllocatedTargetQuery.Step.verified still consumes WordRanges
by reconstructing a finite producer. It is not the needed range-free
observation theorem. done_trace supplies Steps. The richer physical trace
also needs actual instruction-input checks. Derive those checks from the
current source admission. Do not take an unchecked future physical trace.
Inspect native call soundness, ConjunctionCaller.actual and physical effects.

Then expose continuable captured-head preservation from genuine current
parent inputs and the actual CapturedEdge.run/advance observations. Retain
native Post, saved query equality, Admitted, conditional Pending and fragment
history. ChildEffects.child, ChildDispatch.singleton_core, terminal adapter
protection, ordered traversal and captured finalization are relevant layers.

Use recursive-budget induction and inner edge-list induction. A completed
subtree must retain its final native Post and separate Posts/cache invariants
for every output at that output's OWN emission endpoint. Compose Posts through
the head, callback, subtree and suffix. Use the subtree's native Keeps to
restore the SAME captured sibling-input packet. Siblings retain captured
metadata. There is no aggregate final enumeration cache in Recursive.Result.

Completion still needs native capacity at the ACTUAL recursive endpoints.
Legacy NativeBranchCompletion.Ranges follows advance(head). The new worker
evaluates the suffix after the callback and entire subtree. Context and Keeps
do not reserve machine width. More workFuel does not repair width overflow.
The initial instruction/computed budget producers are starting points for an
initial reservation forecast. They do not yet reserve an entire recursive tree.

Terminal/nonordinary outer fallback, native Graph correspondence, full output
language, concrete solvers, physical containers, machine Ints, extraction and
arbitrary Haskell lazy demand remain open. No convergence or practical resource
bound is claimed. Preserve the optimized interned core and older secondary
